observations.title: Auto-start toggle is user-consented
observations.technical_explanation: The entire auto-start feature (checking, creating, and removing a Startup folder shortcut) is controlled by the user pressing 'A' in an interactive console. No persistence occurs without explicit user action, and the feature is clearly documented as opt-in.
observations.layman_explanation: The program can automatically start with Windows, but only if you press 'A' to enable it. It will never auto-start without your permission.
observations.developer_action: None required; the implementation is appropriate for a user-controlled convenience feature.
